    About this home

    This beautifully upgraded 3 bed, 2 bath home is move-in ready with major updates! Exterior repainted in 2018 and new roof in 2019. In 2023, the kitchen was remodeled with quartz countertops, subway tile backsplash, painted cabinets, and now opens to the dining and living areas with updated lighting throughout. Both bathrooms feature stylish modern finishes. The pool/spa received a full makeover with a mini pebble tech finish. Enjoy the stunning backyard with covered patio, lush mature landscaping (updated in 2023), and a new automatic drip system installed in 2024. Don't miss this incredible opportunity!!
